palma.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), same as Italy. Watch for pickpockets in Barcelona and Palma, summer heat waves and wildfires.
palma.note: Jul: Driest, calm month; sea 76F; AEMET airport normals hotter (max 88F, RH 62%). 2026 Balearics had record heat-wave days. Aug: Muggiest month (2 of 3 days); sea 79F; AEMET 1.8 thunderstorm days, late-summer storms begin. Sep: Storm season starts: AEMET 3.9 thunderstorm days, 50 mm; DANA/gota fria downpours possible; sea 76F. Oct: Wettest of the four (AEMET 62 mm, 6 days >=1 mm); pleasant temps, sea 72F.

tramuntana.station: Mallorca - NW Tramuntana (Deia; Port de Soller similar)
tramuntana.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), same as Italy. Watch for pickpockets in Barcelona and Palma, summer heat waves and wildfires.
tramuntana.note: Jul: ~4F cooler than Palma; sea 76F; mountain wildfire risk in Serra de Tramuntana. Aug: Muggy most days; sea 79F; afternoon mountain thunderstorms possible. Port de Soller: 85/67F, 20 muggy days. Sep: Rain days rise (6+); sea 76F; heavy autumn storms hit mountains first. Oct: Windier from early Oct, westerly shift late month; Port de Soller 7.4 wet days.

costabrava.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), same as Italy. Watch for pickpockets in Barcelona and Palma, summer heat waves and wildfires.
costabrava.note: Jul: Mild highs; some convective storms; sea warm (>70F early Jul-late Sep). Aug: Peak mugginess; sea 73F; 2026 Les Gavarres fire (~2,200 ha) was right behind this coast. Sep: Tramontana (north wind) episodes; sea still >70F to ~Sep 24. Oct: Wettest month here (~74 mm); windier season from ~Oct 18; autumn torrential rain risk on Catalan coast.

barcelona.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), same as Italy. Watch for pickpockets in Barcelona and Palma, summer heat waves and wildfires.
barcelona.note: Jul: Warm nights (low 68F) and humid sea breeze; sea 75F. Aug: Muggiest; sea 77F; tropical nights common. Sep: Late-summer storms; sea 75F; Sept is historically one of the wetter months on the coast. Oct: Comfortable; most rain of the four; sea 69F.

penedes.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), same as Italy. Watch for pickpockets in Barcelona and Palma, summer heat waves and wildfires.
penedes.note: Jul: Inland of coastal range: less muggy than Barcelona; Weather Spark model may understate inland peaks. Aug: Calmest month; harvest begins late Aug; storms possible. Sep: Grape-harvest season; noticeably drier air than coast. Oct: Near zero muggy days; cool evenings (53F).

toledo.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), same as Italy. Watch for pickpockets in Barcelona and Palma, summer heat waves and wildfires.
toledo.note: Jul: Very hot, dry heat; frequent 100F+ days in heat waves; 2026 Burgohondo/Villa del Prado fire (~50,000 ha) touched Madrid/Avila/Toledo. Aug: As July; heat waves (AEMET 2026: Jul 28-Aug 20 wave). Avoid. Sep: Still warm (82F) but dry; nights cool to 58F. Oct: Pleasant days, chilly nights (50F); rain rises.

malaga.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), same as Italy. Watch for pickpockets in Barcelona and Palma, summer heat waves and wildfires.
malaga.note: Jul: Essentially rainless; terral (hot offshore wind) can push 100F+; sea ~71F (Alboran). Aug: Hottest, muggiest; terral risk; sea ~73F. Sep: Still dry; sea ~71F. Oct: First autumn rains; occasional DANA downpours; sea ~68F.

ronda.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), same as Italy. Watch for pickpockets in Barcelona and Palma, summer heat waves and wildfires.
ronda.note: Jul: Altitude ~740 m: cooler nights. LOWER CONFIDENCE: CRU-based highs; other sources show ~86-90F (estimate) in Jul/Aug; Weather Spark has no Ronda page. Aug: Dry heat; inland Andalusia had record fires in 2026 (Niebla, Huelva). Sep: Comfortable days; cool nights. Oct: Rain rises sharply (~10 days); cool evenings.

lisbon.safety: US advisory Level 1 (normal precautions). Petty theft in central Lisbon; summer heat and wildfire season inland.
lisbon.note: Jul: Steady north wind (Nortada), low humidity; Atlantic sea only 65F. Cascais 78/66F; Sintra 77/64F with summer fog/mist. Aug: Dry; heat-wave spikes to 95-100F possible in Lisbon; Cascais/Sintra 5-10F cooler. Sep: Calmest month; great conditions; Cascais 77/65F, 6.3 muggy days. Oct: Rainy season begins (~7 wet days); Sintra hills wetter and foggier.

comporta.safety: US advisory Level 1 (normal precautions). Petty theft in central Lisbon; summer heat and wildfire season inland.
comporta.note: Jul: PROXY: no Comporta page. Sines (coast) shown; Grandola (~20 km inland) 86/62F. Breezy, sea 66F. Aug: Grandola 85/63F; coastal pine forests carry fire risk. Sep: Grandola 81/61F; dry, settled. Oct: Grandola 72/57F, 7 wet days.

evora.safety: US advisory Level 1 (normal precautions). Petty theft in central Lisbon; summer heat and wildfire season inland.
evora.note: Jul: Dry heat; heat waves often 104F+ in Alentejo interior; big day-night swing. Aug: As July; State Dept lists Jul-Aug heat waves for Portugal. Sep: Warm, dry, very low humidity. Oct: Mild; rain returns.

porto.safety: US advisory Level 1 (normal precautions). Petty theft in central Lisbon; summer heat and wildfire season inland.
porto.note: Jul: Coolest option; morning fog/low cloud; sea 63F (cold). Aug: Mild; occasional heat spikes when east wind blows. Sep: Rain picks up (~5 wet days, 51 mm). Oct: AVOID: wettest of all regions (~112 mm, 10.5 wet days); southerly storm season starts mid-Oct.

douro.station: Douro Valley (Peso da Regua; Pinhao hotter)
douro.safety: US advisory Level 1 (normal precautions). Petty theft in central Lisbon; summer heat and wildfire season inland.
douro.note: Jul: Model smooths the valley floor: river-level venues often reach 95-104F (estimate); 2026 fires in Vila Real district (~16,000 ha). Aug: Hot, dry; wildfire season; harvest begins late Aug/Sept. Sep: Harvest season (vindima); warm days, cool nights; rain rising. Oct: Wet (~112 mm, 10 wet days); cool.

faro.safety: US advisory Level 1 (normal precautions). Petty theft in central Lisbon; summer heat and wildfire season inland.
faro.note: Jul: Virtually rainless; sea 69F; levante (east wind) can bring muggy, hot days. Aug: Sea 70F; muggier than Lisbon. Sep: Calmest; sea 70F; very reliable weather. Oct: Sea 68F; rain starts (~6 wet days). Lagos (west) 3-5F cooler, breezier.

lagos.safety: US advisory Level 1 (normal precautions). Petty theft in central Lisbon; summer heat and wildfire season inland.
lagos.note: Jul: Breezy Atlantic; sea 67F; inland Monchique hills are fire-prone. Aug: Calmer; sea 68F. Sep: Calmest month; sea 68F. Oct: Mild; rain starting.

athens.safety: US advisory Level 1 (normal precautions). Petty theft in Athens; strikes can disrupt transport; July-August heat and wildfire season.
athens.note: Jul: Hot, warm nights (74F); meltemi (north wind) ~10 mph avg, gusty; Athens hit ~43C (109F) on 22 Jul 2026 with Category-5 fire alert in Attica. Aug: Peak meltemi and fire season; 2026 W. Attica megafire (~14,400 ha). Sea 78F. Sep: Heat eases; sea still warm; good month. Oct: Pleasant; first storms; sea still swimmable.

nafplio.safety: US advisory Level 1 (normal precautions). Petty theft in Athens; strikes can disrupt transport; July-August heat and wildfire season.
nafplio.note: Jul: Hottest coastal site in set (94F); sheltered gulf, little breeze; dry heat; sea 77F. Aug: As July; Peloponnese fire season (2026 firefighter death 29 Jul). Avoid. Sep: Still hot (86F); sea 77F. Oct: Ideal temps; sea 73F; occasional storms.

chania.safety: US advisory Level 1 (normal precautions). Petty theft in Athens; strikes can disrupt transport; July-August heat and wildfire season.
chania.note: Jul: Hot; meltemi; rainless; sea >74F late Jun-early Oct. Aug: Sea 77F; 2026 Crete fires forced ~8,000 evacuations on the south coast. Sep: Hot but easing; sea warm. Oct: Comfortable; ~6 wet days; sea still ~74F early Oct.

heraklion.safety: US advisory Level 1 (normal precautions). Petty theft in Athens; strikes can disrupt transport; July-August heat and wildfire season.
heraklion.note: Jul: North coast, strong meltemi (~13 mph avg) tempers heat but humid nights (72F). Aug: Muggy ~44% of days; sea 77F; windy. Sep: Good month; sea warm. Oct: Very pleasant; low rain (~30 mm).

catania.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), mainly terrorism, same as Spain. Petty theft in tourist areas; frequent transport strikes.
catania.note: Jul: Hot, muggy, light winds; scirocco heat spikes 104F+; sea 76F. Etna ash closed Catania airport repeatedly 7-14 Aug 2026. Aug: Calmest, muggiest; sea 79F; 2026 Sicily wildfires. Sep: Thunderstorms/medicane risk rises; sea 76F. Oct: Pleasant; heavy-rain events possible.

syracuse.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), mainly terrorism, same as Spain. Petty theft in tourist areas; frequent transport strikes.
syracuse.note: Jul: MOST HUMID site in the set: muggy 2 of 3 days; warm nights 71F; sea 77F. Aug: Muggy ~83% of days; avoid if humidity is a dealbreaker. Sep: Still muggy 60% of days; storms possible. Oct: Comfortable; sea 72F.

puglia.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), mainly terrorism, same as Spain. Petty theft in tourist areas; frequent transport strikes.
puglia.note: Jul: Steady north breeze (~10 mph); muggy ~45% of days; scirocco heat spikes; sea 76F. Aug: Calmest, muggiest; sea 78F; 2026 Alta Murgia fire (inland). Sep: Good; storms increase; sea 75F. Oct: Cooler (68F), ~8 wet days; sea 69F.

florence.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), mainly terrorism, same as Spain. Petty theft in tourist areas; frequent transport strikes.
florence.note: Jul: Basin traps heat; station highs typically low 90sF (model 88F); afternoon thunderstorms. Aug: Hot, still air (5.6 mph); city empties mid-Aug (Ferragosto). Sep: Good temps; ~7 wet days, storms possible. Oct: Wetter (~79 mm, 9 days); cool nights.

casentino.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), mainly terrorism, same as Spain. Petty theft in tourist areas; frequent transport strikes.
casentino.note: Jul: PROXY Bibbiena (~5 km). Upland valley: ~5F cooler than Florence, cool nights, low humidity; afternoon storms. Aug: Good balance of heat and humidity; storms ~5 days. Sep: Mild days, chilly nights (53F); ~7 wet days. Oct: Cool (64/46F); wet; outdoor evening events chilly.

valdorcia.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), mainly terrorism, same as Spain. Petty theft in tourist areas; frequent transport strikes.
valdorcia.note: Jul: Hilltop: low humidity, cool nights (58F); thunderstorms ~4 days. Aug: Best low-humidity Italian option for Aug. Sep: Pleasant days, cool nights. Oct: Cool and wet-ish (~8 wet days).

como.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), mainly terrorism, same as Spain. Petty theft in tourist areas; frequent transport strikes.
como.note: Jul: Mild temps but WETTEST summer in set: ~9 wet days/month, Alpine thunderstorms, hail, flash floods. Aug: Same storm pattern; 2026 Monte Goj fire above Como (50 evacuated). Sep: Comfortable but ~94 mm rain; persistent rain events. Oct: Cool (62/48F) and wet (~99 mm).

garda.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), mainly terrorism, same as Spain. Petty theft in tourist areas; frequent transport strikes.
garda.note: Jul: PROXY Desenzano (~20 km). Warm, humid nights; frequent storms (~7 wet days); Ora/Peler lake winds. Aug: Similar; calmest month. Sep: Good temps; storms continue. Oct: Cool, ~8 wet days.

carmignano.safety: US advisory Level 2 (exercise increased caution), mainly terrorism, same as Spain. Petty theft in tourist areas; frequent transport strikes.
carmignano.note: Jul: PROXY Prato (~10 km); hillside venues slightly cooler. Hot like Florence; storms. Aug: Hot; calmest month. Sep: Good temps; storms possible. Oct: Wetter (~81 mm).
